title_en: 2+1+2 bathroom apartment for sale in the Municipality of Paris!
description_en: 2+1+2 bathroom apartment for sale in the Municipality of Paris! The apartment is located in a building of the year 2025 and has a fantastic location at the beginning of the Commune of Paris! The area is 89 m2. The layout is in the living room, two bedrooms, one of which has a bathroom, corridor, toilet and balcony. It has a south-west orientation. 2nd residential floor. The price is 225,000 euros
